summary: Restore surrounding-whitespace parsing and reject duplicated signs in SimpleAtof and SimpleAtod.
explanation: NumbersTest.Atod expects SimpleAtod("  3.141  ", &d) to return true, but it returns false because only leading ASCII whitespace is stripped and from_chars must consume the remaining input. NumbersTest.Prefixes expects SimpleAtod("+-1", &d) and SimpleAtof("+-1", &f) to return false, but both return true because the parsers skip '+' and then accept '-1'. Strip ASCII whitespace at both ends and reject another sign immediately after the skipped '+'.
